clear-cache-description: Any saves or states stored on the server will not be affected.
clear-cache-title: Are you sure you want to clear the EmulatorJS cache?
clear-cache-warning: This will remove all saves and states stored in the browser.
delete-memory-card-body: This permanently deletes "{name}" and every saved version of it. This cannot be undone.
desktop-error-no-container: That streaming container is not configured.
desktop-error-occupied: This container is already in use. End the session holding it first.
desktop-error-release: The desktop session could not be released. The container may still be in use.
desktop-error-server: The desktop session could not be opened.
desktop-exit-body: The container will be released and anything still open on the desktop will be closed. Emulator settings you saved are kept.
error-hint-auth: You may not have permission to stream, or your login session expired. Try signing in again.
error-hint-broker: The {label} container refused to launch the game. Check the container logs for details.
error-hint-network: RomM could not be reached. Check your network connection and that the server is running.
error-hint-not-configured: Add a container for this platform to RomM's streaming configuration.
error-hint-server: RomM hit an unexpected error while starting the session. Check the RomM server logs.
error-hint-unreachable: The {label} container could not be reached. Check that the container is running and that its broker is listening.
exit-chord-hint: While playing, hold Select + Start for a moment to open the exit menu.
exit-dialog-text: The game is still running. What do you want to do?
exit-dialog-text-loading: The game is still starting. Cancel the launch?
join-closed: That session is no longer open to other players.
jsdos-browser-save-warning: js-dos saves are stored only in this browser and are not synced with RomM.
leave-dialog-text: The host keeps playing. You will drop out of the session.
manual-disc-swap-hint: This emulator changes discs from its own menu, not from here.
memory-card-create-failed: Could not create the memory card
memory-card-delete-failed: Could not delete the memory card
memory-card-download-failed: Could not download the memory card
memory-card-hint: The newest card loads by default. Progress syncs back when you exit.
memory-card-import-body: This container already has a memory card holding {count} save file(s). Import it into your library, or start with a fresh card?
memory-card-import-discard-body: The memory card on this container will be erased. Anything saved on it cannot be recovered.
memory-card-no-data: This card has no saved data yet
memory-card-rename-failed: Could not rename the memory card
memory-card-share-failed: Could not change sharing for the memory card
memory-card-unreadable-body: RomM could not read the memory card on this container, so it cannot tell whether it holds saves. Try again later, or start fresh and erase whatever is on it.
memory-card-unreadable-title: Memory card could not be read
memory-card-unreadable-warning: The existing card will be erased and cannot be recovered.
memory-card-upload-failed: Could not upload the memory card
memory-cards-empty: You don't have any memory cards for this emulator yet.
multiplayer-hint: Shows a Join button on this game's page and keeps chat and webcam visible.
resume-failed: Could not load the selected state. The game started fresh.
save-data-none-hint: {platform} keeps progress in the game's own save
save-data-none-note: Play, then save in-game. It syncs back when the session ends.
save-data-note: Restored to the console before launch. Load it from the game's own menu.
session-ended-by: An administrator ({user}) ended your streaming session.
start-fresh-hint: Pick one below to resume, or hit Play to start fresh.
stream-error-not-configured: No streaming container is configured for {platform}.
stream-error-rom-not-found: This ROM could not be found. It may have been removed.
stream-load-state-failed: The state could not be loaded.
stream-occupied-draining: The previous session is still saving. Try again in a moment.
stream-occupied-fallback: Someone else is currently playing. Try again later.
stream-release-failed: The session could not be released. The container may still be in use.
stream-save-state-failed: The state could not be saved.
stream-save-unconfirmed: The emulator did not confirm the save. Recent progress may be lost.
streaming-description: The game runs in a dedicated {label} container and streams straight to your browser.
swap-disc-failed: Disc swap failed. The console may still be mid-swap, try again.
swap-disc-text: Choose the disc to load. The game keeps running, so save your progress in-game first.
